name: gizza-ai/rabbit-cipher
summary: Encrypt or decrypt data with the Rabbit stream cipher (128-bit key, optional 64-bit IV)

tool.description: Encrypt or decrypt data with the Rabbit stream cipher (RFC 4503 / eSTREAM), a fast 128-bit-key, 64-bit-IV stream cipher. operation = encrypt (default) or decrypt — Rabbit is symmetric. key must resolve to exactly 16 bytes: a 16-char UTF-8 passphrase (key_format=text, default) or hex/base64 (key_format=encoded). iv is optional and, when given, must resolve to exactly 8 bytes; it must match on both sides. The ciphertext (and an encoded key/IV) use format = hex (default) or base64; the plaintext is UTF-8. Keys and IVs are read most-significant-byte first, matching the RFC 4503 test vectors.
